item.title: Tecnologo: FIS 2 Call project “Reconstructing and Investigating the First Roman Imperial Legislation: From Augustus to Nerva – RIFRIL” PRJ-1995 (Univ. PALERMO)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-10-20 12:00
Institution: Univ. PALERMO, Palermo
Field: Law / 12/GIUR-15 Diritto romano e fondamenti del diritto europeo

A selection procedure based on qualifications and examinations is hereby launched at the University of Palermo to fill 1 post of Technologist on a part-time (12 hours per week) and fixed-term (18 months) basis, salary grade EP1, renewable for a maximum of a further 8 months, to be assigned to the Department of Law.
